The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas resulting in #NAME? errors in the statistics section.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with multiple AssertionError messages indicating that cells H46 through L47 contained '#NAME?' instead of the expected numeric values. This error typically occurs when a formula uses an undefined function name or invalid range reference. While the 'net metric' assertions passed, the 'statistics' matrix mismatches suggest a syntax error in the specific formulas applied to the summary rows of the 'Task' worksheet.
